enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain still under the covers. Turn over onto one side. Adjust the pillow. Remain in bed asleep for the rest of the segment.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and getting ready for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet hair and body. Apply soap. Rub arms, torso and legs. Rinse off soap. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up a towel. Dry hair and body. Wrap the towel around. Wipe the mirror with a hand. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Put the toothbrush back. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making a thermos of coffee for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out eggs, bread and milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place items on the counter. Pick up a pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Crack eggs into the pan. Pick up a spatula. Turn the eggs over. Turn off the induction cooker. Pick up a plate. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Pick up the bread. Place bread on the plate. Sit down at the table. Pick up a fork. Cut the eggs. Lift food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Drink milk from a glass. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch. Open the cabinet. Take out the thermos. Open the thermos lid. Pick up a spoon. Put coffee powder into the thermos. Pour hot water from the kettle into the thermos. Stir with the spoon. Close the thermos lid. Pick up the thermos. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the home entrance. Close the door. Walk to the street. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the time on the phone. Put the phone back. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Stand or sit. Watch the stops. Pull the stop cord. Step off the bus. Walk to the hospital entrance. Push the entrance door open. Walk to the ward. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take out the work uniform. Change into the work uniform. Close the locker. Walk to the nurses station. Greet colleagues. Receive the handover report.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient care, medication rounds, charting and handover with colleagues
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the ward. Pick up the patient chart. Read the chart. Walk to the first patient bed. Greet the patient. Check the wristband. Measure blood pressure with the cuff. Wrap the cuff around the arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the reading. Write the value on the chart. Measure temperature. Measure oxygen saturation with the pulse oximeter. Clip the device on the finger. Read the value. Write the value. Adjust the IV line. Check the drip rate. Replace the IV bag. Hang the new bag on the pole. Push the medication cart down the corridor. Stop at each room. Pick up the medication cup. Hand the cup to the patient. Hand a glass of water. Open the pill blister. Drop the pill into the cup. Record the dose on the medication sheet. Sign the sheet. Walk back to the nurses station. Sit at the computer. Type patient notes. Enter medication data. Update the chart. Answer the phone. Speak with the doctor. Write down the order. Stand up. Walk to the supply room. Open the cabinet. Take out gloves, gauze and saline. Close the cabinet. Carry the supplies to the ward. Restock the trolley. Walk to the patient room. Change a dressing. Open the sterile pack. Put on gloves. Clean the wound. Apply the new dressing. Remove gloves. Drop gloves into the bin. Walk to the next patient. Assist the patient to sit up. Help the patient walk to the bathroom. Walk back to the bed. Help the patient lie down. Adjust the pillow. Press the call button within reach. Walk to the nurses station. Sit down. Continue charting. Take a break. Walk to the break room. Sit down. Open the lunch box. Eat with a fork. Drink water. Stand up. Walk back to the ward. Join the handover with colleagues. Read out the patient status. Listen to the incoming shift report. Hand over the keys and the pager. Say goodbye to colleagues.

Walk out of the ward. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Change out of the work uniform. Hang the uniform in the locker. Put on the coat. Close the locker. Walk out of the hospital. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Take the phone out. Check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back. Step onto the bus. Tap the card. Hold the handrail. Watch the stops. Pull the stop cord. Step off the bus. Walk to the home entrance. Take out the keys. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Walk inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing out of work clothes and putting items away
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Take off the coat. Hang the coat on the hook. Take off the shoes. Place the shoes by the door. Unbutton the shirt. Take off the shirt. Drop the shirt into the laundry basket. Take off the trousers. Drop the trousers into the laundry basket. Take off the socks. Drop the socks into the laundry basket. Open the wardrobe. Take out a t-shirt. Put on the t-shirt. Take out sweatpants. Put on the sweatpants. Close the wardrobe. Open the bag. Take out the thermos. Take out the phone charger. Place the thermos on the desk. Place the keys on the desk. Turn off the light. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables, chicken and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place items on the counter. Turn on the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up a knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Push the pieces aside. Cut the chicken into pieces. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the chicken. Stir with a spatula. Add the vegetables. Stir again. Add salt. Turn off the induction cooker. Pick up a plate. Slide the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up chopsticks. Lift food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Drink water from a glass. Stand up. Carry the plate and the glass to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen, keeping power use low during the blackout warning window
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on the tap. Pick up a sponge. Add dish soap to the sponge. Scrub the plate. Scrub the glass. Rinse the plate under the water. Rinse the glass under the water. Place the plate in the drying rack. Place the glass in the drying rack. Scrub the pan. Rinse the pan. Place the pan in the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up a cloth. Wipe the counter. Wipe the stove top. Wipe the table. Open the refrigerator door. Put the leftover food inside. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up the trash bag. Tie the bag. Carry the bag to the bin. Drop the bag in the bin. Do not switch on the dishwasher. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with a book and phone, deliberately avoiding heavy appliances during the evening peak blackout warning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the living room light. Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the book from the coffee table. Open the book. Turn the pages. Read. Place the book on the lap. Pick up the phone from the table. Press the power button. Unlock the screen with a swipe. Scroll through messages. Type a reply. Put the phone down on the table. Pick up the book again. Turn the pages. Close the book. Put the book back on the coffee table. Lean back on the sofa. Stretch arms. Stand up. Do not turn on the TV, computer, monitor, game console, space heater or vacuum cleaner. Turn off the living room light. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Wait for the water to warm. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet hair and body. Apply shampoo. Rub the scalp. Rinse the hair. Apply soap. Rub arms, torso and legs. Rinse off soap. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up a towel. Dry hair and body. Wipe the face. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with the fan on instead of the air conditioner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Pick up the TV remote from the desk. Press the power button on the remote. Set the remote down on the bed. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the remote again. Press the channel button. Press the volume button. Watch the screen. Pick up the fan plug. Insert the plug into the socket. Press the fan power button. Press the fan speed button. Adjust the fan head angle. Continue watching the TV. Do not press the air conditioner power button. Pick up the phone. Unlock the screen. Scroll through apps. Put the phone down. Press the TV power button to turn it off. Press the fan power button to turn it off. Pull the fan plug out of the socket.

enriched_activities.activity: Charging the phone and computer, reviewing tomorrow's shift notes and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the phone charger. Insert the charger plug into the wall socket. Plug the cable into the phone. Place the phone on the nightstand. Open the bag. Take out the computer. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Wait for the screen to load. Open the shift notes file. Scroll down the document. Read the notes. Type a few words. Save the file. Close the document. Shut down the computer. Close the laptop lid. Pick up the charger cable. Plug it into the computer. Place the computer on the desk. Pick up the notebook. Open the notebook. Read the handwritten notes. Close the notebook. Place the notebook on the nightstand. Turn off the bedroom light. Turn on the desk lamp. Adjust the lamp arm. Sit on the bed. Flip through a magazine. Close the magazine. Turn off the desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and final bedtime routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Wet the brush under the water. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse mouth with water. Rinse the brush under the tap. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Pick up a towel. Wipe the face. Wipe the hands. Hang the towel on the rack. Use the toilet. Flush the toilet. Wash hands with soap. Rinse hands. Turn off the tap. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto one side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn over during the night. Remain asleep for the rest of the segment.
